title: Datasheet Battery
source_docs: Powertrain Blockset/Energy Storage and Auxiliary Drive/Datasheet Battery/Datasheet_Battery.md
text: Lithium-ion, lithium-polymer, or lead-acid battery, 2 outputs; {Initial battery capacity} sets the input or parameter, {Output battery voltage} sets the unfiltered or Filter, {Rated capacity at nominal temperature, BattChargeMax} sets the constant, {Open circuit voltage table data, Em} sets the 1-D lookup table 1 -by, {State of charge breakpoints for open circuit voltage, SOCEmBp} sets the breakpoints 1 -by, {Internal resistance table data, RInt} sets the 2-D lookup table N -by, {Battery temperature breakpoints, BattTempBp} sets the breakpoints, {State of charge breakpoints for internal resistance, SOCRintBp} sets the breakpoints, {Number of cells in series, Ns} sets the integer, {Number of cells in parallel, Np} sets the integer, {Initial battery capacity, BattCapInit} sets the capacity, {Output battery voltage time constant, Tc} sets the filter time constant and {Output battery voltage initial value, Vinit} sets the filter initial voltage. Values come from the instance.
